description: Institutional-style US equity research powered by the Wall Street Hedge Fund Suite quantitative MCP engines. Retrieves server-calculated metrics and turns them into sourced, timestamped investment memos.

defaultPrompt: Run a full 360-degree institutional quant analysis on NVDA.
Assess Apple's financial health using Piotroski F-Score and Altman Z-Score.
